info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Settlement Management API
info.description: The Settlement Management API facilitates the cancellation and removal of existing settlement records by utilizing their unique IDs. This endpoint is crucial for businesses requiring the ability to reverse settlements that are no longer valid or contestable. It is particularly useful for financial institutions and payment processors looking to maintain accurate records of transactions and ensure compliance with regulatory standards. Typical consumers include accountants, payment administrators, and financial analysts responsible for maintaining transaction integrity.

delete.summary: Delete a specific settlement by resource ID.
delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a settlement identified by the resource ID. Ensure that you have the necessary permissions to perform this action. Deleting a settlement is irreversible and will remove all associated data.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details for deleting the settlement identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the appropriate parameters are provided to facilitate the successful deletion of the resource.

204.description: Successful deletion with no content returned.
